cards.public_summary: Jonathon Brooks has missed both Panthers practices since the team reduced its roster to 53 players, Mike Moraitis reported.
cards.evidence: In the two practices since the Carolina Panthers cut their roster down to 53 players on Sunday, running back Jonathon Brooks hasn't taken part.
cards.commentary: Brooks' two-practice absence is an availability flag worth monitoring. No reason, injury diagnosis or timetable was provided; his next participation update will clarify whether this is a setback.
cards.author: Mike Moraitis
